summary: Moxi 2.17.0 strengthens distributed Agent lifecycle fencing, restart-safe orchestration, native headless control, and release-contract alignment across every shipped surface.

notes: Workbench remains a protocol client with streamed UI modules and stable automation anchors.
Workflow, solver, and research operations remain available through language-neutral contracts.
Hub packages the synchronized 2.17.0 documentation, brand, and language-pack contracts.
Project, runtime, release, and diagnostics journeys use native desktop command boundaries.
Workbench packages the 30-locale language-pack set and current workflow contracts.
GUI and Python WASM DSL operations share the same product-owned action surface.
Installer packages the 2.17.0 update, integrity, cleanup, and remote deployment contracts.
Installation and replacement behavior remains explicit, inspectable, and rollback-aware.
Headless and distributed control paths remain decoupled from desktop shells.
Process-generation Agent session fencing rejects stale lifecycle events and stale execution claims after replacement.

capabilities: ONNX-like workflow datasets and versioned graph contracts
mixed-physics operator composition through TaskIR and engine protocols
restart-safe orchestration with persisted terminal outcomes and bounded retry recovery
Rust-only worker/operator extension SDK remains distinct from headless control SDKs
operator descriptors, package preflight, TaskIR, and reliability evidence remain release-gated
solver execution remains language-neutral across direct, Agent RPC, and workflow paths
